verdict.rationale: Homebrew's own manpage documents a command for its anonymous aggregate user-behaviour analytics, and `brew analytics off` turns that telemetry off. This is a first-party opt-out of usage tracking. The GitHub README confirms anonymised install, build and OS usage data is collected and published. missing for 10: detail on exactly what data the opt-out stops (e.g. whether any requests still occur), a documented environment-variable opt-out for scripted or agent use, independent or hands-on corroboration that disabling works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote:
`brew analytics off`

Turn Homebrew’s analytics off.
Control Homebrew's anonymous aggregate user behaviour analytics.
View anonymised install, build and operating system usage data at formulae.brew.sh/analytics.
